about: Each outward claim Polaris makes (every badge in README.md and the status lines), where it is published, the evidence behind it and how a stranger reproduces it. Evidence tokens: check:NAME (a check in polaris_checks/checks.py), test:PATH::NAME, drill:PATH, file:PATH, url:https://... (outside evidence, not fetched by the check). A badge's claim is its alt text and its label what the badge image renders. The outside-implementations entry lists each implementation by the name the README gives it and the term that finds its row in the Wallets table of lab/EXTERNAL-NOUNS.md. reproduce is null, with a why, where the claim is a live value an outside service renders. check_claims_manifest holds this file to the README, the evidence it cites and the scoreboard.

claims.why: A live status the CI service renders for main. The workflow is in the tree; its result is on the service.

claims.label: ML-DSA-65: FIPS 204
claims.reproduce: pip install --pre "polaris-verify[cryptography]", then polaris-verify --pqc-provider auto --issuer-anchor vectors/anchors/ml-dsa-65-issuer.json --pack vectors/ml-dsa-65-valid.json, which exits 0; the tampered vectors beside it exit 2.
